dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 02, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MANGUM'S BIG DAY LIFTS PIRATES OVER PHILLIES**

Jake Mangum and Brandon Lowe led the Pirates' offense with three hits each, while Esmerlyn Valdez chipped in with two hits and a run scored. Nick Gonzales had a standout performance, hitting a home run and driving in two runs, and his 4th homer of the season proved to be the difference in the 6-1 win over the Phillies. Jared Jones shined on the mound, striking out six in four innings of work. Carmen Mlodzinski earned the win.

Meanwhile, in other games, Jose Trevino hit a home run and drove in three runs to lead the Reds to a 7-2 win over the Brewers. Jacob Misiorowski was dominant on the mound, striking out ten in five innings of work. The Rockies routed the Marlins 14-4, with Jake McCarthy hitting a home run and driving in four runs.
